title: Los colores · the colours
intro: The one plate that needs no drawing of a thing: the colour is the answer. Colours are adjectives and follow their noun, agreeing with it — una puerta roja, unos zapatos negros. Those ending in -e or a consonant have one form for both genders: verde, azul, gris. claro and oscuro go after the colour and do not agree: unas paredes azul claro.
